title: Separate Binance PoR Publication Status from XRP Replenishment and Quarantine Broad Scheduler Dispatch

decisions.decision: Classify Binance's 12-hour initial PoR snapshot target as elapsed, while keeping public completion unverified.
decisions.rationale: The official page rendered blank metadata at 12:31:30 UTC; dynamic rendering/publication lag remain alternatives, and results were stated due Nov2.

decisions.decision: Do not infer XRP-specific replenishment from Binance's aggregate $1.34B remaining affected-token acquisition plan.
decisions.rationale: No XRP allocation, execution quantity or transaction-level purchase evidence is disclosed.

decisions.decision: Treat the main scheduler as a high-risk broad dispatch/main-write path until a strict allowlist and durable non-main queue state exist.
decisions.rationale: The workflow has contents:write/actions:write; scheduler.py accepts any existing workflow file and commits queue state to main.

decisions.decision: Retain PR #1412 as a temporary read-only scheduler quarantine proposal; do not merge without approval.
decisions.rationale: The queue has zero pending entries, and exact-head CI/gate passed. If merged, future queue dispatch remains paused until the durable scheduler design is implemented.

decisions.decision: Keep PR #1411 as a separate security proposal; the unsafe token-input workflow remains active on main until approved merge.
decisions.rationale: PR #1411 is open/draft/unmerged; its proposed code is not active on main.

decisions.decision: Do not admit Binance reserve changes or the PoR page status as XRP price features; do not issue a directional forecast.
decisions.rationale: Token-specific reserve data and a leakage-safe calibrated model are absent.

decisions.decision: Keep the Nov1 1B XRP escrow event as a scheduled event watch, not a sell-supply assumption.
decisions.rationale: Actual EscrowFinish, re-escrow, destination and exchange disposition remain unknown.

alternatives_considered: Treat blank PoR metadata as proof that the snapshot was not taken — rejected because dynamic rendering/publication lag are possible.
Treat the aggregate $1.34B token acquisition plan as XRP spot demand — rejected because no token-specific allocation is disclosed.
Restore scheduler dispatch with the existing any-workflow-file check — rejected pending strict allowlist and input schemas.
Merge PR #1412 or #1411 automatically after CI — rejected; user approval remains required.
consequences: PR #1412, if approved and merged, pauses automatic scheduler queue dispatch while retaining a read-only queue audit.
No pending queue work was removed; the inspected queue had one completed entry and zero pending entries.
The main scheduler remains write-capable until PR #1412 is approved and merged.
The Databricks token-input workflow remains active on main until PR #1411 is approved and merged.
No XRP market feature is admitted and no forecast is issued.
next_actions: Recheck Binance's public PoR result by 2026-11-02 and compare same-time token reserves against customer liabilities and official reserve addresses.
Crosswalk the five Binance incident XRP source wallets and obtain raw XRPL receiver state.
Observe the Nov1 00:00 UTC XRP escrow objects and capture finish/re-escrow/destination/market disposition.
Review PR #1412 and #1411; do not merge without approval.
Design non-main scheduler state, workflow allowlist, per-workflow input schema, idempotency, concurrency and audit receipts.
Continue fixed-horizon leakage-safe XRP model evaluation; forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.
